text:
harper_marketing: quick heads-up  target announce Tue 10:00 PT. marketing needs final changelog URL, docs slug, a 1-line perf stat for social, and a demo curl by EOD tomorrow. can eng/product commit? :calendar:

noah_eng: changelog PR ready, will merge by EOD. docs draft needs product sign-off. tagging @sylvie_product

sylvie_product: will review docs today and add a short "what this means" bullet and a support one-liner. webinar: Wed 11am PT still good?

harper_marketing: Wed 11am PT preferred so we get post-launch momentum. maya will prep email + social.

maya_marketing: need a 280-char headline + a 280-char variant for the newsletter. also want a 1-line perf blurb for tweets.

noah_eng: perf blurb (draft): "~16% median text-gen latency improvement at 512 tokens; ~22% unit cost reduction with default batching + KV cache." use as teaser.

oliver_release: rollout plan: canary prechecks 09:50 PT, embargo lift 10:05 PT after healthy canary, full ramp by 12:30 PT. deploy-bot will run prechecks.

deploy-bot: Canary precheck scheduled: start=2026-12-10T09:45:00Z, target=canary-pool-9, alert=#eng-oncall.

noah_eng: adding curl demo to changelog and a tiny node fetch example. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/699

sylvie_product: inbound routing note: tag leads "2026-12-infer" and route to SDR queue "launch-inbound" for 72h. adding to docs and webinar slide.

harper_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs sign-off + demo snippets. 09:45 PT prechecks, 09:50 PT canary, embargo lift 10:05 PT, ramp by 12:30 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. please confirm so I can lock calendar. :white_check_mark:

noah_eng: confirmed. merging PR now.

sylvie_product: confirmed  slides + support blurb will be in the drive by 5pm PT.

maya_marketing: confirmed  will draft social + newsletter and drop here for a final eng accuracy pass.

noah_eng: update: final perf run nudged median improvement to 14%. updating PR and docs now. prefixing with "update:" as requested.

maya_marketing: noted  will use 14% in teaser. schedule unchanged. :rocket:
